item.tib: mchog chen grub thob lhun grub dbang ldan gyi bla sgrub snang ba rgyan gyi yid 'phrog thar lam bsgrod pa'i them skas
item.coloph: ces skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi gyi ngo bo gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me gsal dag mtshungs zla ma mchis pa'i sa steng gi skyes bu mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i mchog chen lhun grub dbang ldan la gsol ba 'debs pa'i thabs lam zab mo bla sgrab snang ba rgyan gyi yid 'phrog thar lam bsgrod pa'i them skas 'di yang / rgod rje rgya yi rus thob 7g.yung drung thogs med rtsal lam/ mi ngan ming che la khyi la seng ming du grags pa'i/ g.yung drung grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dbang gi rgyal por 'bod pa bdag la ma gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo'i zhal lung bzhin du dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod du/ tshad med snying rje chen po'i blo yis bskul nas/ bslab gsum yid kyi rta phos nye bar drangs te yi ger bris pa 'dis kyang / sangs rgyas bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la mdo sngags bon gyi sgra dbyangs phyogs bcur sgrogs pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
